ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) field with sparse high-intensity (white/tan) pixel clusters. Estimated white-to-black pixel distribution ratio of approximately 0.08:1.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary surface consists of a continuous black pixel field. High-contrast white circular ring motifs are distributed across both lobes. Dense, multi-colored (tan/white) calcified clusters are localized at the far lateral distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow V-shaped depression with an approximate pixel angle of 115 degrees and a moderate bounding-box depth relative to lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration profile along the entire trailing boundary. Pixel-amplitude of peaks and valleys varies between 5 to 20 pixels, creating a jagged edge isolated against the water background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Outer edges follow a strong upward convex curve towards the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Numerous high-contrast circular white rings (diameter 10-30 pixels) representing barnacle attachment scars, found scattered across the central and upper regions of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several distinct, non-parallel linear white pixel disruptions (scratches) visible on the medial and lateral portions of the left and right lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive colonization of acorn barnacles forming dense, high-contrast clusters at the extreme lateral tips of the fluke.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique circular 'cookie-cutter' style scarring pattern distributed symmetrically across both lobes.
